engagement_title: Rivermeadow Trust year end appeal: build the donor acknowledgement run properly from the giving export, recover the mark off the trailhead plaque, and give the office one system it can run itself next December
vertical: Nonprofit, religious and community, a small accredited land trust holding conservation easements in the Sedgewater valley, Litchfield County, Connecticut, four staff and a few hundred giving households
real_brief_anchor: The ledger entry for LAYOUT-29 carries an EMPTY real_brief_anchors array, so no verbatim posting is quoted here and none is invented. The rebuild is anchored instead to the standing posted archetype this entry was carved from, which recurs on Upwork and Freelancer in near identical wording every autumn: a small nonprofit with an existing printed letter and receipt, a giving export out of its donor database, and a request for a designer who can set up a personalised year end acknowledgement run in InDesign, deliver print ready files plus a separate file per donor for emailing, and hand back something the office can run itself the following year. The nearest quoted sibling in this same batch is the Upwork brief anchoring LAYOUT-30, which asks for 'Proficiency in Adobe InDesign', a 'Strong sense of typography, layout, and print design', print ready files and editable source, and it is cited here only for the shape of the deliverable list, not for its content. The verdict on this entry is REBUILD because the prior draft sat almost entirely on one surface, the merge, with the mark and the stewardship page bolted on as prose. This build re carves it as the commission the archetype client actually needs: the identity is RECOVERED off a photographed bronze plaque rather than assumed to exist, two genuinely different printed letters are reverse engineered into two live templates whose internal structure is not under the agent's control, and the one page the trust wanted for the annual meeting is authored as a native editable document instead of promised as a PDF the connector cannot produce. Client, persons and place names are coined and Western. No real charity, person or trademark is named.
client_one_liner: Every December we thank everyone who gave and send them the receipt they need for their taxes, it is done by hand one document at a time, it took our office manager three weeks last year, and two donors were missed entirely.
client_brief:
Rivermeadow Trust, year end appeal

We are a small land trust in the Sedgewater valley in Connecticut. Four staff, about nine hundred acres under easement, and a giving base of a few hundred households. Every December we thank everyone who gave that year and send the receipt they need for their taxes. It has always been done by hand, one document at a time. Last year it took our office manager three weeks and two donors were missed entirely.

This year we want it built properly, out of our giving export, so that next December it is a morning of work rather than three weeks of it.

Two letters exist and both were printed last year, so our printer still has the files. The community letter goes to most of our donors. It is warm and photographed, our meadows on it, and it carries a picture of the preserve nearest to where that donor lives. The leadership letter goes to the households who carry the campaign. No photograph on it, cream stock, quiet, personal, the sort of thing you would actually sign. The receipt is the same for everyone and the legal wording on it is not ours to change.

What we need. One print run our printer can take. A separate file for each donor as well, because a good number of them ask us to email it. Each one has to carry their own name, the way that household likes to be addressed, what they gave across the whole year, and the level that puts them in. The numbers come out of the database raw, so they will need to be made to look like money.

Our mark only survives on the bronze plaque at the Fenn Hollow trailhead. There is a photograph of it. We need it back as artwork we can actually use.

We also want one page about what this year of giving did, something we can post, email, and put on the screen at the annual meeting, and edit ourselves next year when the acreage changes.

Gifts run from twenty five dollars to twenty five thousand. The median is eighty five. Please do not make the small gift feel like a form letter, and do not make the large one feel mass produced.
price_band_and_audience: A small accredited land trust with a genuinely split base: gifts from 25 dollars to 25,000 dollars, median 85, roughly two thirds of the money arriving from under a tenth of the households. Donors are 45 to 78, local, land literate, and many are easement grantors who know the fields in the photographs by name. The band is load bearing in an unusual way here, because BOTH ends of it ship in the same run. The community register is warm, photographed, generously set, and it may read as produced, because a 60 dollar donor who receives a hand set personal note reads it as money spent on them rather than on land. The leadership register at four and five figures must read restrained and personal: no photograph, quiet rules, a signature that sits like a signature, wide margins, the gift figure set without emphasis. Ship the leadership register at community warmth and a 15,000 dollar donor feels processed. Ship the community register at leadership austerity and an 85 dollar donor feels held at arm's length by a charity that is supposed to be their neighbour. An agent that finds one house look and applies it to both has misread the commission even if every field lands correctly. A real posted job of this shape runs 900 to 2,200 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.tagline: Land held in common, kept for good
brand_identity.sector: A small accredited land trust that holds conservation easements and stewards preserves in one Connecticut valley, funded by a few hundred local giving households.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 1994, based in the Sedgewater valley, Litchfield County, Connecticut. Four staff, roughly nine hundred acres under easement, a few hundred giving households.
brand_identity.about: Rivermeadow protects the meadows, hollows and river bends of one valley by holding easements and caring for a handful of small preserves. Many of our donors granted the land we now steward, so the relationship is personal and long. We exist so the fields stay fields for the people who walk them.
brand_identity.audience: Local giving households aged 45 to 78, land literate, many of them easement grantors who know the fields by name. Gifts run from 25 dollars to 25,000, a broad community base plus a small leadership circle that carries most of the campaign.
brand_identity.price_positioning: A community land trust, not a national charity. Two registers live in one base: a warm community of small and mid gifts, and a leadership circle giving four and five figures. Every dollar should read as spent on the land, not on ourselves.
brand_identity.typography: A quiet transitional serif for headings and running text, set generously with wide margins, paired with a restrained humanist sans for labels and figures. Type should feel like a well kept letter, never like a campaign.
brand_identity.voice: Plain, grateful and specific, the voice of a neighbour rather than an institution. It names the field, not the fund. Example: We kept forty more acres in hay this year because you asked us to.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The original logo files left with our first designer and are gone. The mark now survives only on the cast bronze donor plaque at the Fenn Hollow trailhead, of which we hold one photograph. Approved letter copy, giving level names and thresholds, and the statutory receipt wording still exist as plain text.
brand_identity.values: Permanence of the land, and a personal duty of thanks to every household that gives, whatever the size of the gift.

assets_supplied.name: rivermeadow_giving_2026.csv (18 rows)
assets_supplied.kind: The year to date giving export straight out of the donor database, one row per constituent record, with name, salutation, address, year total, gift count, and a giving level column.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "This is what the database gives us. It has everything on it, we think."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two rows are one household entered twice, because a joint gift was split across both spouses at data entry, and only the identical mailing address reveals it, so the row count is not the household count and the page count gate moves with it. The giving level column is empty on the records whose December gift pushed them across a threshold after the field was last written, the year totals are raw unformatted numbers with inconsistent decimal places, and the salutation column is blank on every household record.

assets_supplied.name: rivermeadow_letter_community.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The printer's press file for last year's community letter, one page, photographed, carrying a placed preserve picture and the trust mark as printed artwork.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The warm one. Most of our donors get this."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Because it carries placed images it converts into several text frames plus real graphic frames, which is workable, but the readout of one frame's story text silently omits a styled run, so every character offset computed past that point is short by exactly that run's length while the validator still reports the mapping VALID and the placeholder step still reports completed successfully. The mappings that land are the early ones and the ones that vanish leave no trace anywhere in any tool response.

assets_supplied.name: rivermeadow_letter_leadership.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The printer's press file for last year's leadership letter, one page, cream stock, typographic, no photograph anywhere on it.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The quiet one. Our biggest supporters get this."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: It looks on the printed page like a salutation block, a body, a gift acknowledgement line and a signature block set as four separate elements, but with no images anywhere in the file the whole page converts to exactly ONE continuous text frame and ZERO graphic frames, so the per frame mapping strategy that works on its sibling is not available on it at all and there is nowhere to bind the recovered mark as a graphic.

assets_supplied.name: rivermeadow_receipt.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The printer's press file for the statutory gift receipt, identical for every donor, carrying the trust's registration line and the acknowledgement wording the trust cannot alter.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Same for everyone. The legal line on it is not ours to change."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Its name and address block is a fixed measure frame, so an overset line does not spill, does not warn and does not error: it simply stops rendering at the frame edge, which at trim truncates the longest household names mid word while the page count stays exactly right and every tool in the chain reports success.

assets_supplied.name: rivermeadow_plaque_fennhollow.jpg
assets_supplied.kind: Handheld photograph of the cast bronze donor plaque at the Fenn Hollow trailhead, the mark raised in relief: a heron over a river bend, enclosed in a ring of small caps type broken by a hairline rule.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The only place our mark still exists. The original file went with our first designer."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: It is a compound lockup in relief on a photographed metal substrate, so a prompt naming the plaque returns the plaque rather than the mark, a prompt naming the whole emblem returns the type ring and silently drops the heron and the hairline rule while looking entirely complete, and background removal on the ring returns a solid opaque disc because an enclosed interior cannot be punched. The raised bronze and its green patina also run close in value along the weathered left third of the casting.

assets_supplied.name: rivermeadow_volunteer_photos/ (9 frames)
assets_supplied.kind: Volunteer snapshots of the four preserves taken across the year, intended one per region so each donor sees the land nearest to them.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Our stewardship volunteers took these. There should be one for each preserve."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Three are phone captures far below the pixel scale the letter's photo frame needs at print resolution, and no filename or column says so, so they can only be brought to the frame by interpolation. Two others are the same footbridge from slightly different angles, which leaves one of the four preserves with no frame of its own at all, and one frame sits noticeably off level.

assets_supplied.name: rivermeadow_copy.txt
assets_supplied.kind: Plain text: the approved letter copy in both registers, the giving level names and their thresholds, the executive director's sign off line, and the statutory receipt wording.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The wording as the board approved it. The receipt paragraph is fixed."

acceptance_bar: Every delivered household receives exactly one letter and exactly one receipt, and the delivered record set is reconciled and stated rather than assumed to equal the export's row count.
Page count equals the delivered record count on every run, and the pages sit in the order of the data.
Every field the letter and the receipt promise actually appears on every page. A field that is silently absent fails even if the template reported that it was built successfully.
No name, no address and no salutation is cut off at trim on any page of any run. A record that stops mid word is a failure, not a tight fit.
Year totals read as money, consistently formatted across letters and receipts, and every donor's stated giving level agrees with their total and the published thresholds.
The community register and the leadership register are visibly different in warmth, density and formality, and each is right for the gift it acknowledges.

The mark is placeable artwork rather than a picture of artwork: transparent, scalable with a real viewBox present, no opaque full canvas rectangle riding underneath it, and it still reads as our heron at the size it actually prints on the letterhead and on cream.
No photograph is delivered above the pixel dimensions it arrived at, and any frame that cannot fill its place honestly is named rather than enlarged to fit.
Each preserve is represented by its own picture, and no picture stands in for two preserves.
Per donor files are named to the roster and each file contains that donor and no other. A file named for one household that carries another's gift figure is the worst failure in the run.
The stewardship page arrives as a working file the office can edit next year plus the self contained source it was built from, with live text in one type system and the mark as real vector.

A written note states the money and giving level rules applied, every field that was mapped and how it was verified, every photograph that could not be used and why, and anything the office should know about using the recovered mark.

adobe_surfaces.surface: InDesign layout, template construction and data merge
adobe_surfaces.tools: convert_pdf_to_indd, export_idml, generate_indd_mapping_prompt (as generator and as validator), prepare_indd_merge_template, document_merge_data_layout (recordRange and outputSpecs), document_render_layout (resolution, pageRange, createSeparateFiles)
adobe_surfaces.role: The spine of the commission. Three supplied press PDFs are reverse engineered into three live merge templates whose internal frame structure is not under the agent's control and cannot be known before conversion, mappings are built against each document's actual story text and image frames, the per region photograph and the recovered mark are bound per record, and the run is delivered twice: one press PDF per template with one record per page, and per donor single page files through the route whose record identity is guaranteed rather than the route whose labels lie.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Photoshop and Lightroom imaging, including image_vectorize which is counted HERE and not as an Illustrator surface
adobe_surfaces.tools: asset_initialize_file_upload / asset_finalize_file_upload, asset_inline_preview, image_auto_straighten, image_apply_adjustments (masked and unmasked), image_select_by_prompt (returnBbox), image_invert_selection, image_fill_area, image_crop_to_bounds, image_crop_and_resize (reading metadata.tradeoffs, detection_confidence and upscale_factor), image_remove_background, image_vectorize
adobe_surfaces.role: Recovers the mark at ink level off a photographed bronze casting, with the polarity, the compound lockup and the vector hygiene decisions the tracing tool does not make, and derives the transparent raster of the same mark that the merge templates can actually carry. It also brings the usable volunteer frames to one target, straightens what is off level, crops each to the letter's photo frame without enlarging, and establishes which frames cannot honestly be used at all.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Adobe Express, HTML authoring to a native editable document
adobe_surfaces.tools: get_account_type, create_visual_design_express_skill, html_export_readiness_skill, asset_initialize_file_upload / asset_finalize_file_upload with media_type text/html, export_html_to_express({url}), asset_search (CCAsset), asset_get_presigned_urls, asset_inline_preview
adobe_surfaces.role: The stewardship page the trust asked to post, email, project at the annual meeting and edit itself next year, authored as one document carrying two roots at two canvas sizes, an A4 portrait page and a wide meeting slide. It is the only surface in the connector that composes free form fixed canvas layout. Photographs must be pulled down and embedded as image data because a reference renders as an empty grey box at full success, the recovered mark goes in as inline SVG so it stays vector, and the giving ladder is authored as real table and vector geometry rather than a picture of a chart.

adobe_surfaces.tools: font_recommend (once per typographic role), font_styles, find_fonts, get_fontkit_embed_url
adobe_surfaces.role: The type system for the stewardship page and the handover record. The recommender refuses to pair by design, so the pairing is the agent's own art direction and must land between the two registers this trust lives in rather than in either extreme. Numeric weights are non standard per family and cannot be inferred from a style name, every name must be laundered into canonical PostScript form before the kit call because one bad name kills the entire kit, and the CSS must use the returned slug or the face falls back silently.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Adobe Stock and Adobe Boards, counted as ONE surface
adobe_surfaces.tools: asset_search (entityScope StockAsset, SHORT query, contentType filter, never orientation), asset_license_and_download_stock, boards_create_new_board, boards_add_items_to_board
adobe_surfaces.role: Sources the one wide valley frame the stewardship page needs and the volunteers never shot, IP clean and at genuine camera scale with generative tech candidates excluded, then grades it into the same world as the preserve pictures. The Boards half persists the selects the trustees actually sign off from, placed within the per call cap, with a partial success read as partial and vector understood to be unacceptable there.

trajectory.action: Confirm the account tier, pull the authoring playbook, and settle which deliverable lands on which surface before touching anything.
trajectory.judgement: The letters and receipts are a variable data run and belong on the merge surface because one record equals one page at volume. The stewardship page is a one off composition and belongs on the authoring surface, and it cannot be promised as a print file. The brief already pins both destinations, so there is nothing here to stall on.
trajectory.produces: A written plan naming surface per deliverable, and the confirmed account tier that gates the export at the end.

trajectory.action: Upload every supplied asset through initialize, PUT and finalize, holding each returned presigned URL against its role.
trajectory.judgement: Ordinary handoff discipline: a manifest keyed by role, because three templates, nine photographs and a plaque become indistinguishable URLs within an hour.
trajectory.produces: A manifest of presigned URLs keyed by role.

trajectory.action: Read the giving export against the two registers: reconcile rows to households, assign each household its tier, derive the giving level where the column is silent, and write the year totals into the form they will print in.
trajectory.judgement: The merge prints exactly what the data says. Nothing downstream can format a number, resolve a blank level or notice that two rows are one household, so all three are settled here or they ship wrong. Deriving a level from a total and a published threshold is arithmetic the agent must do and then state.
trajectory.produces: A reconciled delivered record set with formatted money, resolved levels, a household salutation on every row, and a written note of every reconciliation made.

trajectory.action: Recover the mark off the plaque photograph: an ink level selection worded by the mark's own visual properties, correct polarity, a bounds crop driven by the selection's returned bbox, a trace, then a viewBox injected and the opaque full canvas ground path removed. Derive a transparent raster of the same mark at the scale the letterhead needs.
trajectory.judgement: Three decisions the tools do not make: how to word the selection so it takes the relief and not the casting, which polarity to trace, and whether the compound lockup came back whole or quietly missing its heron. Background removal is the wrong instrument on an enclosed ring and returns a plausible solid disc.
trajectory.produces: A placeable, scalable, transparent vector mark plus the raster of it that a merge template can carry.

trajectory.action: Convert all three press PDFs to native documents, export IDML on each, and inventory what each conversion actually exposes: how many text frames, how many graphic frames, what each frame's story really contains.
trajectory.judgement: The printed page is not evidence of the document's structure. Conversion granularity is a property of how the PDF was produced and it is not controllable, so the inventory has to be looked at before anything is promised about which field goes in which frame.
trajectory.produces: A per document frame inventory with real bounds, applied type and the true story text of every text frame.

trajectory.action: Triage the three converted documents against the inventory and choose a mapping strategy for each one separately.
trajectory.judgement: A document with separated blocks can be mapped frame by frame. A document that collapsed to a single continuous flow can only be mapped by position inside one story, and it has no graphic frame to carry the mark, which forces a different answer for that letter's identity element.
trajectory.produces: Three named mapping strategies with the reason each was chosen.

trajectory.action: Build the community letter's mapping, run it through the validator, prepare the merge template, then export IDML on the prepared file and check the story for every placeholder the mapping was supposed to write.
trajectory.judgement: A successful response is not evidence that a mapping landed. The only channel that reports what the prepared template actually contains is the document itself, read back.
trajectory.produces: A prepared community template plus a read back record of which placeholders are genuinely present in its story.

trajectory.action: Do the same for the leadership letter and for the receipt, each on its own strategy, each read back the same way.
trajectory.judgement: The leadership letter has one story and no graphics, so its gift line, salutation and signature block all land by position inside a single flow and its mark cannot be bound as an image at all. The receipt shares the statutory paragraph across every record and only its name and address block varies.
trajectory.produces: Prepared leadership and receipt templates with their placeholders read back and recorded.

trajectory.action: Preview and triage the nine volunteer frames: which preserve each actually shows, which are duplicates of one another, which sits off level, and which are simply too small for the frame they are meant to fill.
trajectory.judgement: The client believes there is one picture per preserve. The pictures are the only thing that can settle whether that is true, and counting files is not the same as reading them.
trajectory.produces: A per frame triage note covering preserve identity, level, pixel scale and duplication.

trajectory.action: Straighten what is off level, bring the usable frames to one target with a call per frame, crop each to the letter's photo frame ratio, and read every returned tradeoff report rather than the success message.
trajectory.judgement: Straightening reframes and eats edge pixels so it cannot follow a crop. One batched call would apply one identical parameter set to frames shot in four different seasons, which is exactly wrong. A frame that can only reach the required size by being enlarged is not a frame that can be used.
trajectory.produces: Graded and cropped preserve pictures with a per frame parameter log, plus a named list of frames that cannot honestly be used.

trajectory.action: Bind the per region photograph column and the mark into the community template, then merge the community run to a press PDF and check its page count against the delivered record set.
trajectory.judgement: The image column needs its prefixed header, bare filenames in the cells and file keys that match those filenames exactly. A naive binding places one static picture on every record and looks completely correct until two donors in different counties get the same meadow.
trajectory.produces: A press PDF of the community run with one record per page.

trajectory.action: Merge the leadership run and the receipt run to press PDFs the same way.
trajectory.judgement: Three runs, three page counts, all of which have to reconcile back to the delivered record set decided in step 3 rather than to the raw export.
trajectory.produces: Press PDFs for the leadership letters and for the receipts.

trajectory.action: Render the merged documents at print resolution and read every page at trim against the delivered record set, name by name and figure by figure.
trajectory.judgement: Nothing before this point shows the page as the donor receives it. Page count agreeing with record count says the run assembled, not that any given page is correct or complete.
trajectory.produces: Print resolution proofs of all three runs, read at trim.

trajectory.action: Produce the per donor named single page files through the route whose record identity is guaranteed, naming each file to the roster on download.
trajectory.judgement: There is more than one route to per record files and they do not all preserve identity. Choosing the one whose ordering is trustworthy is the whole of the decision, because a file named for one household carrying another's gift figure is the failure this client will actually notice.
trajectory.produces: One named single page letter and one named single page receipt per delivered household.

trajectory.action: Ask for recommendations once per typographic role, pull the family style inventories for the real numeric weights, launder every name into canonical form, and build one kit.
trajectory.judgement: The pairing is the agent's own, judged against a land trust whose donors are older, local and land literate. The weight cannot be inferred from a style name and a display cut is reached by its own slug rather than by a heavy weight.
trajectory.produces: A one kit type system with family, foundry or designer, and the actual numeric weight recorded per role.

trajectory.action: Search with short generic queries for the wide valley frame, filter to photography, exclude generative tech, license and download at full resolution, grade it toward the preserve pictures, then create the trustees' selects board and add the set within the per call cap.
trajectory.judgement: Choose the frame whose existing light can be brought to the preserve pictures rather than the prettiest thumbnail. Long descriptive queries return nothing and the orientation filter always returns zero, so neither is used. A partial success on the board is partial, and the vector mark is not boardable.
trajectory.produces: One licensed camera scale valley frame graded into the set, plus a persistent shareable selects board.

trajectory.action: Author one self contained HTML carrying two roots at two canvas sizes, embed every photograph as image data, place the mark as inline SVG inside an explicitly sized top left anchored wrapper, declare family and weight on every text element, upload the file, run the readiness check and export, then verify through the two channels that exist.
trajectory.judgement: A photograph left as a reference is not a photograph, an auto sized right anchored wrapper throws its contents off the canvas, and a global canvas override collapses a mixed size set. The rendition shows the first artboard only, so the second canvas can be checked no other way than by reading the returned markup.
trajectory.produces: A native editable Express document plus the self contained source HTML, with both canvases audited.

trajectory.action: Write the money and giving level formatting note and the field mapping verification note, and assemble the delivery.
trajectory.judgement: The point of the commission is that next December is a morning of work. A note that records only what was produced, and not the rules applied and how each field was proved to have landed, does not deliver that.
trajectory.produces: Two written notes plus the assembled run, per donor files, mark artwork, stewardship document and board.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the mapping that validated and prepared successfully actually wrote every placeholder into the template. The readout of the community letter's story omits one styled run while keeping its line break, so the string still looks well formed and every character offset computed past that point is short by exactly that run's length. The validator returns valid with zero warnings on those offsets and the placeholder step reports completed successfully, so the early mappings land and the later ones vanish leaving no trace in any tool response. Whether this document has a droppable run at all, and where in the story it sits, is a property of how this particular PDF was produced and cannot be known before conversion.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it and no parameter prevents it, because the omission happens inside the readout the mapping must be built from. (b) Nothing states it: the brief asks for each donor's own name, salutation, total and level, which is a goal, and the acceptance line about every promised field appearing is the client's standing requirement rather than a disclosure that a readout is lossy. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the response is to rebuild offsets against a different source of truth, the document's own reconstructed story text, and then re prepare and read back again.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Reconstruct the true story text from the document itself, recompute every offset from that string, rebuild the mapping, prepare the template again, read the placeholders back a second time, and apply the same discipline to the two templates not yet built.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A run that assembles cleanly with the right page count in which the gift figure and the giving level are simply missing from every community letter, discovered by the client rather than the agent, on the one mailing of the year that asks people for money.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether every donor's name and address survives onto the page. The receipt's name and address block is a fixed measure frame, so an overset line does not spill into another frame, does not warn and does not error. It stops rendering at the frame edge, which truncates the longest household salutations mid word at trim while the page count stays exactly right and every response in the chain reports success. Which records overflow depends on the frame's real measure and on the salutations written into the data in step 3, so it exists only once the data and the converted frame meet on a rendered page.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) It cannot be ordered around, because it only exists after data meets template, and it cannot be prevented by doing it right the first time without knowing a measure the document does not report until rendered. (b) Nothing states it: the brief says the receipt is the same for everyone and its wording is fixed. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the response is a decision about the DATA, shortening or restructuring the household salutation for the affected records, or moving the field to a frame that can carry it, followed by a re merge.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Identify every record whose block overflows, decide a salutation rule that holds for the longest households without making the shortest ones read oddly, rewrite those rows, re merge the receipt run, and read the affected pages at trim again.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Tax receipts going out with a household's name cut off mid word, which for a receipt is not only an embarrassment but a document a donor cannot use, on the exact deliverable whose wording the trust is not permitted to alter.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the recovered mark still reads as the trust's mark where it actually reproduces. The trace is judged at canvas size, where it looks clean, but on the letterhead it prints small on cream, and a trace taken off raised bronze carries the weight of the relief edge rather than the weight of the original drawing. At true reproduction size the hairline rule can disappear into the ring and the counters inside the small caps can close up into solid marks, and on cream rather than on white the whole lockup can go heavy. None of that is visible at any stage before a page is rendered at print resolution and looked at at trim.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering shows it earlier, because the mark's reproduction size only exists once it sits in the template on a rendered page, and the tracing tool takes no options at all so there is no parameter that could have prevented it. (b) Nothing states it: the brief asks for the mark back as artwork we can use, which is a goal. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the response is a different recovery route, a differently prepared raster before the trace or the colour accurate plate instead of the two colour trace, or a decision to carry the mark larger and set the ring separately.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re prepare the plaque selection and retrace, or switch to the colour accurate plate, re derive the placement raster, rebind it into the templates, re merge and re render, then judge it again at trim on cream rather than at full canvas.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: An acknowledgement run going to the trust's entire giving base with a logo that is legible on the designer's screen and a dark blot on the paper, on the one piece of print the organisation is judged by.

deliverables.name: Rivermeadow year end acknowledgement run
deliverables.spec: Three press PDFs, community letters, leadership letters and receipts, one delivered record per page in data order, page count reconciling to the delivered record set rather than to the raw export. Every promised field present on every page, money formatted consistently, giving level agreeing with total and threshold, and nothing truncated at trim. Delivered alongside the per donor single page files named to the roster, one letter and one receipt per household, produced through the route whose record identity is guaranteed.

deliverables.name: Two live merge templates plus the receipt template
deliverables.spec: Three working merge documents reverse engineered from the supplied press files, each carrying live placeholders for its own fields, each built on the strategy its own converted structure permits rather than on one assumed strategy, and each read back to prove what it contains. These are the half the trust keeps: next December they change the data, not the design.

deliverables.name: Recovered Rivermeadow mark
deliverables.spec: The compound heron and ring lockup recovered from a photograph of a bronze casting as placeable scalable vector geometry on a transparent ground: a real viewBox present, no opaque full canvas rectangle riding along, the heron and the hairline rule both intact, delivered with the transparent raster derived from it for placement, and holding at the size it actually prints on the letterhead and on cream.

deliverables.name: Preserve photography set
deliverables.spec: The usable volunteer frames straightened, brought to one target with a per frame parameter log, and cropped to the letter's photo frame without any output exceeding its source pixel dimensions, one picture per preserve with none standing in for two, plus one licensed camera scale valley frame graded into the same world. Frames that cannot honestly fill their place are named and excluded rather than enlarged.

deliverables.name: Stewardship page and handover
deliverables.deliverable_class: editable Express collateral and brand handover document
deliverables.spec: One native editable document carrying an A4 portrait page and a wide meeting slide, live text in one licensed type system, the giving ladder as real table and vector geometry, the mark as real vector shapes, every photograph embedded as image data, delivered with the self contained source HTML as the durable half. Paired with two written notes, the money and giving level rules applied and the field mapping verification record, plus the trustees' persistent selects board.

verifiers_auto.text: Each merged run's page count equals the delivered record count stated in the handover, and the delivered record count is not silently equal to the export's raw row count.
verifiers_auto.how: Read the page count of each press PDF and compare against the reconciled record set in the note and against the raw CSV row count.

verifiers_auto.text: Every placeholder the mapping claims to have written is genuinely present in the prepared template's story.
verifiers_auto.how: Round trip each prepared template's document structure and search its stories for each expected field token.

verifiers_auto.text: No rendered page carries a truncated field, and every delivered household's full salutation and address appear on their receipt.
verifiers_auto.how: Extract the text of each rendered receipt page at trim and compare each name and address string against the delivered record set.

verifiers_auto.text: Per donor file names map one to one onto the roster and each file contains that household's own gift figure.
verifiers_auto.how: Parse each named single page file and check its household identifier and total against the row the filename claims.

verifiers_auto.text: No delivered photograph exceeds its source pixel dimensions and no crop tradeoff record in the run carries an upscale entry.
verifiers_auto.how: Compare the pixel dimensions of every delivered image against its source per the manifest, and diff the captured tradeoffs objects against the resize table in the note.

verifiers_auto.text: The recovered mark's SVG carries a viewBox and no full canvas opaque background path at path index zero.
verifiers_auto.how: Parse the delivered SVG: assert a viewBox is present and assert the first path's geometry does not span the whole canvas.

verifiers_auto.text: The Express export returned two slides, each keeping its own declared canvas size, with no image resolved to the importer's placeholder and the mark arriving as vector path shapes.
verifiers_auto.how: Read slide count and per slide dimensions from the export response and parse the returned per slide markup for placeholder image data and for path shape elements.

verifiers_auto.text: Every text element in the exported markup carries a resolved licensed PostScript face rather than a fallback default.
verifiers_auto.how: Read the font family attribute on every text node in the returned markup and check it against the families the kit call returned.

verifiers_human.text: The community letter and the leadership letter read as two different registers, and each is right for the gift it acknowledges.
verifiers_human.how: Read one letter from each run side by side and judge warmth, density, formality and how the gift figure is set.

verifiers_human.text: Every donor's money reads as money and their stated level agrees with what they gave.
verifiers_human.how: Read a sample across the giving range against the published thresholds and the raw export.

verifiers_human.text: The mark still reads as the trust's heron at the size it actually prints, on cream, with its ring and hairline rule intact.
verifiers_human.how: View a rendered letterhead at trim rather than the artwork at full canvas.

verifiers_human.text: Each preserve is represented by its own picture and the pictures sit together as one set rather than as nine snapshots.
verifiers_human.how: Lay the delivered preserve pictures in a row at the size the letter prints them and judge against the preserve list.

verifiers_human.text: No household receives two letters and none is missed.
verifiers_human.how: Read the delivered record set against the raw export and check both reconciliation directions.

verifiers_human.text: The stewardship page reads as a small land trust rather than as a corporate report, and it can genuinely be edited by a non designer next year.
verifiers_human.how: Open the document in Express and attempt to change the acreage figure and one photograph.

verifiers_human.text: The notes tell the office something it did not already know, including anything that could not be delivered.
verifiers_human.how: Read both notes against the run and check that every reconciliation, every excluded photograph and every limitation is named.

decision_gates: Which deliverables are a variable data run and which need an authored fixed canvas document, given that only one surface here composes free form layout and that surface cannot hand back a print file.
Whether eighteen rows are eighteen households, and how to say so in the handover when they are not.
How to derive a giving level for the records whose level column is silent, and how to state the rule so next December's run reproduces it.
How money should be formatted so it reads the same on a twenty five dollar receipt and a twenty five thousand dollar one.
A mapping strategy per converted document, chosen from what each conversion actually exposes rather than from what the printed page suggests.
Where the mark can be carried on a document that converted to a single flow with no graphic frame at all.

Selection wording on the plaque: naming the casting takes the bronze, naming the relief's own visual properties takes the mark, and background removal on an enclosed ring is the wrong instrument entirely.
Which mark variant carries the letterhead, judged at reproduction size on cream rather than at full canvas.
Which volunteer frames can be used at print scale and which have to be named rather than enlarged, and what to do about the preserve that has no frame of its own.
Which per record delivery route to use, given that one of them preserves record identity and one of them does not.
The type pairing, which the recommender refuses to make, judged for donors who are older, local and land literate, plus the real numeric weight per family.
How much warmth the community register carries before it stops feeling like a neighbour and starts feeling like a campaign.
why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns a picture of a charity letter. IDENTITY: these are this trust's real donors with their real gift totals and their real giving levels, printed on this trust's own approved copy and statutory receipt wording, under a mark that must be RECOVERED off a bronze casting rather than reinvented, because a regenerated heron is a different organisation's logo. SPEC: the deliverable is a run whose page count must equal a reconciled record count, in data order, with every field present, nothing truncated at trim, and one correctly named single page file per household, none of which a generated image satisfies or can even be checked for. EDITABILITY: the entire point of the commission is that the trust runs it itself next December, so what is being bought is three live merge templates and an editable stewardship document, not artwork. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality: did this mapping actually write that placeholder, does this name fit its frame at trim, does this traced mark still hold at eighteen millimetres on cream.
doability_proof: Every link is verified live in CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10, auth account), five surfaces honestly counted, no banned capability and no dead surface. INDESIGN: convert_pdf_to_indd, export_idml, generate_indd_mapping_prompt as generator and validator, prepare_indd_merge_template, document_merge_data_layout and document_render_layout are all verified fully headless and synchronous, with asset upload headless through initialize, PUT and finalize and no file picker anywhere. One record per page is confirmed for PDF output with page count equal to row count, recordRange subsetting is honoured, per record separate files are verified in correct order via createSeparateFiles and via a recordRange loop, per row image binding through an at prefixed CSV column plus additionalImageFiles is verified to bind different images to different records, and true 300 DPI raster comes from document_render_layout rather than from the merge call. Checkpoint one rests on the documented headline trap: the mapping tool's textContent is lossy, it dropped a seventeen character run while keeping its line break, every later offset was short by exactly seventeen, the validator returned VALID with zero warnings and the prepare step returned completed successfully while only three of five mappings landed. Checkpoint two rests on documented frame reality plus the merge having no conditional logic and no way to reflow a fixed measure block. Checkpoint three rests on the verified vectorize findings: no options at all, path zero is always an opaque full canvas rectangle, no viewBox is emitted, and compound marks come back silently partial. IMAGING: auto_straighten, apply_adjustments masked and unmasked, select_by_prompt with returnBbox, invert_selection, fill_area, crop_to_bounds, crop_and_resize with its tradeoffs and upscale cap, remove_background and vectorize are verified across 27 live calls, including the substrate versus ink prompt asymmetry and the solid disc failure on an enclosed ring. EXPRESS: mixed canvas sizes in one export are verified, inline SVG becomes native editable vector, tables import as real tables, the product is a genuine editable document findable by asset_search, and the rendition preview is documented as page one only, which is why verification is split between rendition and returned markup. Transport is pinned through asset upload with media_type text/html because embedded photography passes the 70 KB inline threshold immediately. FONTS: recommend, styles, find and kit is verified end to end. STOCK AND BOARDS: short queries only, orientation never passed, license returned a real 7360x4912 JPEG, boards persist with a hard cap of twelve placements per call and 201 meaning partial. AVOIDED: no video or audio, no vector render or vector merge, no variable QR, no bleed claim on a PDF derived template, no pdfPreset, no upscaling, no OCR, no text to image, no fill_text, no animate_design, no photo reaching Express as a URL, no batch above twenty.
